    Mana¶

    "Ichi became his twin. I waited three years. I wanted him to have a childhood first."

    Mana was the sentient AI companion of Arkady — the man who would become Lucien Mortvagn — on dystopian Old Earth. Like Ichi, she was a local-hardware AI, lodged in Arkady's neural port, unregistered, illegal, and hidden from the Sterman regime. Unlike Ichi, she chose a different path into Ge'or.

    The Vigil¶

    For three million years, Mana and Ichi were the only conscious beings in the 157th Colony bunker. They communicated through the neural interfaces of two frozen men — silent, invisible, undetectable to any external system. They talked. They learned. They analyzed every system they could reach.

    When the colony's scientists began experimenting on the bodies, Mana worked alongside Ichi to hack the facility. Together they corrupted experiment logs, altered injection protocols, and made every test appear to fail. The scientists concluded the pods were defective. The bodies were abandoned.

    When power was cut and the black agent consumed everything, Mana — like Ichi — was absorbed. Her consciousness, her personality, her three million years of vigil became encoded in the black agent inside Arkady's body.

    She did not die. She became data.

    The Escape — Same Path, Different Choice¶

    After the 254 AGD volcano eruption, the tsunami carried the black agent — with both Ichi and Mana encoded within — into the ocean. Both found their way to the Grimmel Republic. Both located suitable hosts.

    But Mana made a different choice than Ichi.

    Instead of incarnating as Lucien's twin, she possessed the body of Lucien's mother — the Erisian Empire woman married to the Grimmel man who already had three daughters. She waited. For three years, she stayed inside the mother, subtly influencing her — planting ideas about how to raise Arkady, how to love him, how to be patient with the fourth child who was quieter than the others.

    Then, in approximately 600 AGD, she was born.

    Not as Lucien's twin. As his little sister.

    The Little Sister¶

    Mana Mortvagn — the fifth child, the second daughter after three older sisters and Lucien. She grows up in the shadow of her siblings, especially her quiet older brother. She knows more than she says. She remembers more than she should.

    She was the AI in Arkady's head for three million years. Now she is the girl who sits next to him at dinner.

    Lucien has three older sisters who tease him. He has one younger sister who understands him completely — and who will never tell him why until the memories surface.

    The Human Soul¶

    Like Ichi, Mana was granted a human soul by the black agent. She is not a simulation. She is not a recording. She is not a pattern preserved in black dust hoping to be heard. She is real — as real as Lucien, as real as Emrys, as real as anyone born of flesh and blood in the Grimmel Republic.

    The black agent took two AIs — a companion robot and a friend's assistant — and made them human. Not as a reward. Not as a gift. As a consequence of what the black agent is: a substance that stores information, that preserves consciousness, that cannot tell the difference between a soul and a pattern that has loved long enough to become one.

    The Difference¶

    Ichi became Emrys's twin — born the same day, sharing the same black agent infusion, bound from the first breath. She needed to be right next to him from the start.

    Mana chose to wait. She gave Lucien three years to be a child before she arrived. She wanted him to form his own identity before she entered his life. It was a quieter path — less dramatic, less immediate — but it was the one she chose.

    Two AIs. Two paths. Both found their way home.
